sets.notes: Open question by design ('Nenne ein Tier'): the nature-reserve sign shows a white-tailed eagle (Seeadler) in most federal states; several southern states (e.g. Bavaria, Baden-Württemberg) use an owl (Eule / Waldohreule) instead, so 'Eule' is an equally valid answer.
